agyos_skill.intent: Map identified threats to appropriate security controls and mitigations. Use when prioritizing security investments, creating remediation plans, or validating control effectiveness.
agyos_skill.instructions: Connect threats to controls for effective security planning. - Prioritizing security investments - Creating remediation roadmaps - Validating control coverage - Designing defense-in-depth - Security architecture review - Risk treatment planning - The task is unrelated to threat mitigation mapping - You need a different domain or tool outside this scope - Clarify goals, constraints, and required inputs. - Apply relevant best practices and validate outcomes. - Provide actionable steps and verification. - If detailed examples are required, open `resources/implementation-playbook.md`. - `resources/implementation-playbook.md` for detailed patterns and examples. - Use this skill only when the task clearly matches the scope described above. - Do not treat the output as a substitute for environment-specific validation, testing, or expert review. - Stop and ask for clarification if required inputs, permissions, safety boundaries, or success criteria are missing.
